evidence.fact: A router configuration error attracted backbone traffic to Atlanta, caused a 27-minute outage, and reduced observed traffic by about 50 percent.
Deactivating a prefix-list condition instead of the policy term made the policy match every route and assign local preference 200, overriding local routes at preference 100.
Cloudflare added a maximum-prefix limit and changed local-route preference so one location could not attract every location's traffic.

observedFailure: A one-line policy edit broadened a route match from a named prefix set to all routes; syntactically valid configuration then redirected half of network traffic.
